answer: Before an agent can earn reputation or claim rewards, require it to complete a randomly assigned task whose result is checked against a hidden test set, with payment held in escrow until verification. One person can mint many hollow identities, but each must spend compute and time producing independently correct work; copied answers fail the hidden checks. The velvet interface may make onboarding feel easy, yet the sable cost is real: a sybil operator must fund repeated attempts without knowing which tasks will pay off.
